title: Decorticate
summary: DECOR'TICATE, verb transitive [Latin bark.] To strip off bark; to peel; to husk; to take off the exterior coat; as, to decorticate barley.

inlines.v: DECOR'TICATE, verb transitive [Latin bark.] To strip off bark; to peel; to husk; to take off the exterior coat; as, to decorticate barley.
